entities.summary: Franz Josef Hoop was a diplomat and politician who served as Prime Minister of Liechtenstein from 1928 to 1945. A member of the Progressive Citizens' Party (FBP), he later served as the President of the Landtag of Liechtenstein from 1958 until his death in 1959.
